analytics.name: Analytic 1361
analytics.guidance: Monitor for anomalous access to financial applications, browser-based banking sessions, or enterprise ERP systems from Windows endpoints. Detect mass emailing of payment instructions, sudden rule changes in Outlook for financial staff, or use of clipboard data exfiltration tied to cryptocurrency wallet addresses.

tuning.description: Baseline of finance-related executables or ERP processes to monitor closely.
Accounts belonging to finance, treasury, or executives that should be monitored with higher sensitivity.

analytics.name: Analytic 1362
analytics.guidance: Monitor server and endpoint logs for unusual outbound network connections to cryptocurrency nodes, unauthorized scripts accessing financial systems, or automation targeting payment file formats. Detect curl/wget activity aimed at exfiltrating transaction data or credentials from financial apps.

tuning.description: Whitelisted IPs for finance-related traffic to reduce noise.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of curl, wget, or custom scripts accessing financial endpoints

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Authentication attempts into finance-related servers from unusual IPs or times

analytics.name: Analytic 1363
analytics.guidance: Monitor unified logs for access to payment applications, browser plug-ins, or Apple Pay services from non-standard processes. Detect anomalous use of Automator scripts or keychain extraction targeting financial account credentials.

tuning.description: Financial or payment applications to explicitly monitor for unauthorized use.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Non-standard processes invoking financial applications or payment APIs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Anomalous keychain access attempts targeting payment credentials

analytics.name: Analytic 1364
analytics.guidance: Monitor SaaS financial systems (e.g., QuickBooks, Workday, SAP S/4HANA cloud) for unauthorized access, rule changes, or mass export of financial data. Detect anomalous transfers initiated via SaaS APIs or new MFA-disabled logins targeting finance apps.

tuning.description: Customizable monetary threshold above which financial transactions should be flagged.

log_sources.name: saas:finance
log_sources.channel: Transaction/Transfer: Unusual or large transactions initiated outside business hours or by unusual accounts

analytics.name: Analytic 1365
analytics.guidance: Monitor email and document management systems for fraudulent invoices, impersonation of vendors, or BEC-style payment redirections. Detect abnormal editing of invoice templates, or emails containing known fraud language combined with attachment delivery.

tuning.description: Adjustable keyword list for email and document fraud detection.

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: MailSend: Outlook messages with suspicious subject/body terms (e.g., urgent payment, wire transfer) targeting finance teams

log_sources.name: m365:office
log_sources.channel: Anomalous editing of invoice or payment document templates
